lines.text: Samuel, old and gray, tells Israel to witness against him if he ever took an ox or donkey.
When Jacob went to Egypt, the fathers cried out, and the LORD sent them Moses and Joshua.
The fathers forgot the LORD and were sold to Sisera, then cried out, and the LORD sent Jerubbaal, Barak, Jephthah, and Samuel.
When Nahash king of the Philistines moved against them, the people demanded a king even though the LORD was their king.
Samuel called on the LORD during the wheat harvest, and the LORD sent thunder and rain that day.
